brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has publicly lauded harsh conditions imposed on Palestinian female prisoners, according to Al Jazeera English. The minister's comments followed the release of prison footage documenting the treatment of detained Palestinian women.

Palestinian civil society groups have denounced both the footage and Ben-Gvir's remarks, characterizing the conditions as systematic humiliation and intimidation. Activists argue the prison treatment reflects broader patterns of abuse against Palestinians held in Israeli custody. The incident has intensified scrutiny over detention practices and conditions for women in the prison system.
dek: Palestinian groups condemn prison footage as humiliation and intimidation.
title: Ben-Gvir praises harsh prison conditions for Palestinian women
